name: Madonna
hook: A dance-club regular whose second album, produced with a disco veteran, made her name a byword for pop reinvention.
blurb: Madonna Louise Ciccone broke through with 'Like a Virgin' (1984), produced by Chic's Nile Rodgers, a dance record that was both a provocation and pure pop craft. That set the pattern early: her defining trait is deliberate reinvention, of her image and her sound, across five decades, from dance-pop to electronic to whatever came next, rather than any single sound. She is also on this map because Weird Al parodied 'Like a Virgin' as 'Like a Surgeon' (1985), and this project takes its own name from that song. Unlike some artists' more complicated reactions to being parodied, her approval was straightforward.

signatureTracks.title: Like a Virgin
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Produced by Nile Rodgers; the breakthrough that made her a permanent pop fixture and the direct target of Weird Al's 'Like a Surgeon'.

signatureTracks.title: Vogue
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Ballroom voguing brought into the pop mainstream, and a clean example of her recurring pattern of absorbing an underground scene into a hit single.
